Op. 16 exists (IMSLP: Six Trios for guittar, violin and Piano Forte or Violoncello, Rutherford). The only recording found is NAR's mixed Giardini/Noferi disc: its tracks name neither composer nor opus. Six 3-4 movement trios (Pian & Forte with Dandolo; durations match this entry) may be Op. 16, but disc numbers 1-6 = Op. 16 Nos. 1-6 is an assumption, and a second group of six 'Sonata' tracks (guitar quartet) is unassigned (Noferi also wrote Op. 12 solo guitar sonatas). Also: the 'cello or piano' bass could fold into continuo.
